name: business-os-platform
description: Business OS platform monorepo (apps/api, apps/workspace, packages/*, tools/*).

scripts.stack:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml -f infra/compose/compose.dev.yaml --profile core up -d --wait --wait-timeout 300
scripts.stack:down: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml -f infra/compose/compose.dev.yaml --profile core --profile app --profile tools down --remove-orphans
scripts.stack:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml -f infra/compose/compose.dev.yaml --profile core --profile app logs --follow --tail 100
scripts.seed: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml -f infra/compose/compose.dev.yaml --profile tools run --rm seed-zitadel
scripts.perf:load: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml -f infra/compose/compose.dev.yaml --profile tools run --rm -e K6_READ_P95_MS k6 run /perf/load.js
